The split stays perfectly clean — all `schedule`-triggered research-agent.yml runs SUCCEED, every `workflow_dispatch`-triggered run FAILS. Failure on both deep-tier claude-code-action steps: `##[error]Action failed with error: Workflow initiated by non-human actor: github-actions (type: Bot). Add bot to allowed_bots list or use '*' to allow all bots.` Root cause (unchanged): scout / coverage-critic escalate via scripts/escalate-research.js -> `gh workflow run research-agent.yml -f tier=deep` using the job's GITHUB_TOKEN (deliberate — it carries actions:write, unlike the agent's OIDC app token; WP-91). A GITHUB_TOKEN dispatch runs with actor github-actions[bot], and anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 rejects bot actors unless allow-listed. research-agent.yml sets no `allowed_bots` on any of its three claude-code-action steps, so 100% of escalations die on arrival — the scout/coverage-critic -> research escalation fast lane (a core coverage feature) is entirely non-functional. Verified the action's matching logic directly (anthropics/claude-code-action src/github/validation/actor.ts isAllowedBot): it lowercases and strips a trailing `[bot]`, so the actor `github-actions[bot]` normalizes to `github-actions` and a list entry `github-actions[bot]` (or `github-actions`) matches exactly.
